schools.name: Williamston

state_titles.notes: Unbeaten. First title since 1940. Beat Freeland 65-45 in the semifinal; won six tournament games by an average of 26 points before the final.

notable_players.name: Max Burton
notable_players.accolades: 6-foot-10 post. Scored 23 points in the 2022 Division 2 Final as Williamston finished 27-0.

notable_players.name: Mason Docks
notable_players.accolades: Point guard. Scored 27 points with six 3-pointers in the 2022 Division 2 Final, including the overtime 3 that put Williamston ahead for good.

notable_players.name: Jacob Wallace
notable_players.accolades: 10 points, 8 rebounds and 3 assists in the 2022 Division 2 Final; 12 points in the semifinal.

notable_coaches.name: Floyd Eby
notable_coaches.notes: Coached the 1940 Class C state champions.

notable_coaches.name: Tom Lewis
notable_coaches.notes: Led the unbeaten 2022 Division 2 champions in his sixth season.

uncertain: 1992 and 1993 Class C semifinals come from michigan-football.com (fan-compiled). 1940 season record not found. Green hex is approximate.
